info.title: Oddzy basket API
info.description:
Basket-related endpoints of two separate internal services that share the host `app.oddzy.xyz`. Each path carries its own `servers` override because the base URLs differ.

### 1. Bot mini-app API — `/webapp/v1/*` (tag: *Bot mini-app API (/webapp/v1)*)
Served at `https://app.oddzy.xyz` (also `https://app.polybaaz.com`) with no path prefix. Used by the Telegram Mini App and the oddzy.xyz / polybaaz.com web apps. camelCase JSON.

**Auth** (`authenticate`): either
- `X-Telegram-Init-Data: <raw initData>` — Telegram WebApp initData, HMAC-verified against the EN or FA bot token, `auth_date` must be < 24h old; or
- `Authorization: Bearer <Privy access token>` — verified against Privy JWKS (browsers on oddzy.xyz).

initData is tried first and wins when both are sent. Failures: 401 `unauthorized`, 404 `no_account` (valid identity but no user row — onboarding), 403 `blocked`. `community-baskets` and `creator` are public with optional auth (personalisation only); `event` is unauthenticated.

**Rate limits**: per user, fixed 60-second window; 429 `{"error":"rate_limited"}`. basket=30/min (GET /basket), bet=10/min shared by /bet, /basket-buy and /basket-retry, basket_create=3/min, follow=30/min, event=30/min per visitorId (silently 204).

**MONEY-MOVING:** `POST /webapp/v1/basket-buy` and `POST /webapp/v1/basket-retry` place REAL Polymarket orders from the user's wallet. Do not "Try it out" against production with a real user's credentials.

### 2. oddzy-api — read-only (tag: *oddzy-api (read-only)*)
Plain Node http service () mounted at `https://app.oddzy.xyz/api` (Traefik `PathPrefix(/api)`, prefix stripped). GET only (other methods: 405). snake_case JSON, every body carries `as_of` + `max_staleness_minutes`; `Cache-Control: no-store`.

**Auth**: `Authorization: Bearer <API_TOKEN>` (constant-time compare, header only — no query-string token). 401 `unauthorized` otherwise. Never buys anything; prices are DB-synced mids, not executable quotes.

servers.description: Default host. Each path overrides `servers` with its API's real base URL.

tags.name: Bot mini-app API (/webapp/v1)
tags.description: Fastify routes in the bot process at https://app.oddzy.xyz (and app.polybaaz.com). Auth: X-Telegram-Init-Data or Privy bearer.

tags.name: oddzy-api (read-only)
tags.description: Read-only content API at https://app.oddzy.xyz/api. Auth: static bearer API_TOKEN.

servers.description: Bot Fastify server (Traefik router `sportsbot`, no path prefix)

get.description: Read-only and cheap: leg prices are NOT quoted. Requires an account. No rate limit. `Cache-Control: no-store`.

401.description: No valid credential: initData missing/invalid/older than 24h AND no valid Privy bearer token.

404.description: Authenticated but no account row yet (`no_account`) — send to onboarding.

post.description: Validated by parseBasketSpec + applyBasketSpec (same rules as the config seeder and admin API) and published LIVE immediately, with the caller as creator (earns the sharer rebate on every buy; self-buys earn nothing). Slug is server-derived and salted. Always sizing=weights, curated=false. Rate limit: 3/min per user (bucket `basket_create`). Note: no CORS preflight (OPTIONS) handler is registered for this path.

400.description: Shape errors. Messages: "Name your basket.", "That name is too long." (name > 80 or creatorName > 32), "A basket holds 2 to 10 positions.", "That name has characters we can't use."

401.description: No valid credential: initData missing/invalid/older than 24h AND no valid Privy bearer token.

409.description: Salted slug collided with an existing basket ("Try publishing again.").

429.description: Rate limited ("You're publishing baskets quickly. Give it a minute.").

servers.description: Bot Fastify server (Traefik router `sportsbot`, no path prefix)

get.description: Resolves published AND archived baskets (archived = readable record, not buyable). Prices every kept leg at the live executable ask (Gamma). Without `size`, priced against a nominal $100. The optional buyer edit (`keep` + `w`) is applied before pricing, so minStake/payout reflect the edited basket. Rate limit: 30/min per user (bucket `basket`).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Stake in USDC to split. Non-numeric/<=0 falls back to 100. No upper bound here.

parameters.name: keep
parameters.description: Buyer edit: comma-separated marketIds to keep (subset of the basket's legs). Absent/blank = basket as curated. Unknown id -> 400 unknown_leg; duplicates ignored.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Optional weight overrides, comma-separated `<marketId>:<bps>` pairs (positive integers). Only read when `keep` is set; malformed pairs are dropped. If any override survives, every kept leg needs one (else 400 bad_weights). Ignored on equal_shares baskets. Renormalised to 10000 bps.

400.description: `bad_request` ("slug is required") or a rejected selection: `unknown_leg`, `no_legs`, `bad_weights`.

401.description: No valid credential: initData missing/invalid/older than 24h AND no valid Privy bearer token.

servers.description: Bot Fastify server (Traefik router `sportsbot`, no path prefix)

post.summary: BUY a basket — places REAL orders
post.description: **Money-moving.** Re-derives and re-quotes the split server-side from `sizeUsdc` (client prices never trusted), then places each buyable leg sequentially on Polymarket under one per-user bet lock, from the user's delegated embedded wallet. Basket must be `published` (archived -> 404). Skipped legs' stake is NOT redistributed; dropped (edited-out) legs' stake IS. Checks the wallet's available balance first (400 `insufficient_balance`). Once orders are placed, returns 200 even on partial/failed fills. Rate limit: 10/min per user, SHARED with single bets and /basket-retry (bucket `bet`).

400.description: Validation / placement refusal. `bad_request` (slug is required), `bad_size` ("Amount must be between $0 and $10,000."), `unknown_leg`/`no_legs`/`bad_weights` (selection), `below_min` (includes `minStake` when raised by the handler; may also come from placement without it), `bad_legs` (leg not in basket — should be unreachable). `insufficient_balance` (sizeUsdc exceeds the wallet's available balance; includes `free`).

minStake.description: Only on the handler's below_min check.

free.description: Available pUSD balance. Only on insufficient_balance.

401.description: No valid credential: initData missing/invalid/older than 24h AND no valid Privy bearer token.

409.description: `locked` (another bet/basket in flight) or `no_legs` (nothing buyable right now).

servers.description: Bot Fastify server (Traefik router `sportsbot`, no path prefix)

post.summary: Retry failed legs of a basket purchase — places REAL orders
post.description: **Money-moving.** Manual retry (receipt's Retry button). Only legs with filled=false and a retryable reason (no_fill, order_error, price_moved, no_quote, unbuyable) are re-attempted, each at a FRESH live price with the original requestedUsdc; legs whose market has since closed are marked `settled`. Fills land on the same buy id. Ownership checked server-side. Rate limit: 10/min per user, shared `bet` bucket. Error bodies carry only `error` (no `message`).

401.description: No valid credential: initData missing/invalid/older than 24h AND no valid Privy bearer token.

404.description: `no_buy` (no such buy OR not the caller's — same answer on purpose) or `no_account`.

servers.description: Bot Fastify server (Traefik router `sportsbot`, no path prefix)

get.description: PUBLIC: no auth required. If a valid initData or Privy token for a non-blocked user is sent, it only personalises `viewerFollows` and enables the `following` tab; any credential problem is treated as anonymous (never 401). Published baskets only (editorial + user), limit 30. No rate limit. `Cache-Control: no-store`.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: all = curated first then newest; hot = recency-weighted buys; bought = all-time buy_count; following = creators the viewer follows (empty when anonymous). Unknown values -> all.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Root topic slug (lowercased); a basket matches if ANY leg is under it. Invalid shape is ignored; unknown slug -> empty feed.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text ILIKE over titleEn, titleFa and creator name (trimmed, first 64 chars).

servers.description: Bot Fastify server (Traefik router `sportsbot`, no path prefix)

get.summary: Creator (or house desk) profile with baskets and performance
get.description: PUBLIC, optional auth (personalises viewerFollows). Published + archived baskets with legs (limit 60). `house`, `house-daily`, `house-world` are the editorial desks (curated baskets with no creator). No rate limit.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Creator user id (Telegram ids positive, web-auth ids negative) or a house desk id.

404.description: No published/archived baskets for this id (indistinguishable from unknown creator, on purpose).

servers.description: Bot Fastify server (Traefik router `sportsbot`, no path prefix)

post.description: Idempotent both ways. Rate limit: 30/min per user (bucket `follow`). Following an id with no user row hits a DB foreign key and would surface as a 500. No CORS preflight handler registered for this path.

401.description: No valid credential: initData missing/invalid/older than 24h AND no valid Privy bearer token.

404.description: `no_creator` — the creator id does not exist (checked on follow only; unfollow always succeeds).

servers.description: Bot Fastify server (Traefik router `sportsbot`, no path prefix)

post.description: Unauthenticated. Writes an allowlisted event to audit_log as `web_<event>` with actor `web:<visitorId>`. Always 204: invalid event/visitorId, rate limit (30/min per visitorId) and DB errors are silently dropped.

get.summary: Every published basket with payout headline
get.description: Read-only from the DB snapshot (no live quotes). Published only (archived excluded). Unpaginated. Prices are stored mids synced by the indexer. Non-GET methods return 405 `method_not_allowed`.

401.description: Missing/wrong bearer token. Sets `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="oddzy-api"`.

get.summary: One basket with every leg's market
get.description: Resolves published AND archived baskets (archived permalinks stay up as records). For archived baskets `payout` and `blended_probability` are null; use `result`. Legs are field-for-field identical to GET /markets/{slug}.

404.description: No published/archived basket with this slug.

telegramInitData.name: X-Telegram-Init-Data
telegramInitData.description: Raw Telegram Mini App initData query string (Telegram.WebApp.initData). HMAC-SHA256 verified against the EN or FA bot token; auth_date must be within 24h; identifies the Telegram user id. Takes precedence over Authorization.

privyBearer.description: Privy access token for web logins (Google, MetaMask, Telegram-in-browser...). Verified against Privy JWKS. Identity only; orders are always signed by the user's delegated embedded wallet.

oddzyApiBearer.description: oddzy-api static token (API_TOKEN env). Header only.

BasketSizing.description: weights = creator's stored split; equal_shares = same share count in every leg, split proportional to live price.

BasketListItem.description: One published basket in the Baskets tab. Leg prices are NOT quoted here; GET /webapp/v1/basket prices them.

baskets.description: status=published only, ordered curated DESC, sort_order ASC, buy_count DESC; limit 50.

BasketPayout.description: What the buyer gets back (USDC) if the basket comes good, computed from buyable+priced legs only. All fields null and staked=0 when nothing is priced.

staked.description: Total staked across buyable legs (may be < the requested size if legs skip).

allHit.description: Payout if EVERY leg resolves YES. Null on exclusive baskets (cannot happen).

multiple.description: allHit / staked. Null when allHit is.

singleEven.description: Set when every single-winner payout is within 1% (equal-shares sizing).

singleMultiple.description: singleEven / staked. Null unless payouts are even.

BasketResultAtPublish.description: What `notional` (100) staked at PUBLISH prices returned. Only present when every leg has settled and every non-VOID leg has a publish price. VOID returns stake flat. Same basis as creatorPerf.

won.description: Legs whose outcome equals the held side.

LegSkipReason.description: settled = market not active; no_quote = no Gamma quote; unbuyable = quote but no ask on this side; below_min = leg stake under MIN_BET_USDC.

BasketDetailLeg.description: Every leg the basket declares, in declared order, including ones the buyer dropped (kept=false, stakeUsdc=0).

kept.description: False when dropped by the `keep` selection.

titleFa.description: Persian market title; null when untranslated.

weightBps.description: EFFECTIVE weight for this purchase (renormalised after a drop/override); the creator's weight for dropped legs.

stakeUsdc.description: This leg's share of `quotedFor`, whole cents (largest-remainder split).

price.description: Live executable buy price (best ask) for this side; null when unavailable.

outcome.description: Resolution once the market resolves; null while undecided (on an archived basket: pending, not a loss).

BasketDetail.description: One basket, priced and split. The split for a real `size` is exactly what /basket-buy executes.

exclusive.description: At most one leg can resolve YES.

minStake.description: Smallest stake giving every (kept) leg MIN_BET_USDC, rounded up to the cent. Computed for the EDITED basket.

archived.description: Closed, not buyable. Gate buy UI on this, not on leg buyability.

quotedFor.description: Echo of the size priced against (`size`, or 100 when absent/invalid).

customized.description: Response reflects a buyer edit (subset and/or weight override).

BasketLegSelectionItem.description: A kept leg: either a bare marketId string, or an object with optional integer weight override (bps, >0). Items that are neither are skipped.

weightBps.description: Override; ignored unless a positive integer. Ignored entirely on equal_shares baskets. If any override is given, every kept leg needs one.

slug.description: Basket slug. Must be status=published (archived is NOT buyable).

sizeUsdc.description: Total USDC to spend. Also must be >= the edited basket's minStake. Not checked against balance here; insufficient funds surface as per-leg failures.

legs.description: Optional buyer edit (subset of the basket's legs, optional re-split). Absent/empty = buy as curated. Ids must belong to the basket; duplicates are de-duplicated; weights renormalised to 10000 bps server-side.

src.description: Attribution source (e.g. `ig_0903`); lowercased; invalid values silently dropped. Reporting only.

visitorId.description: First-party visitor cookie; invalid values silently dropped. Reporting only.

LegFailureReason.description: Why an unfilled leg didn't fill. settled/no_quote/unbuyable/below_min = never tried; no_fill/order_error/etc = tried and the market said no.

BasketReceiptLeg.description: Buy-time snapshot of one attempted leg (from basket_buys.legs). Title is English on purpose.

requestedUsdc.description: What this leg was allocated from the stake.

BasketBuyStatus.description: failed = 0 legs filled; filled = every attempted leg filled; else partial.

BasketBuyReceipt.description: Returned with 200 even on a partial or failed fill: money may have moved, and the per-leg breakdown is the answer.

customized.description: Echoed so the receipt can say "4 of 4 bought" on a trimmed basket.

legs.description: Only the legs THIS purchase attempted.

buyId.description: basket buy id from a /basket-buy receipt. Must belong to the caller.

BasketRetryReceipt.description: Same receipt shape as /basket-buy (minus `customized`, plus `retried`). Totals recomputed over ALL legs of the original buy.

retried.description: How many legs were actually re-attempted this call.

slug.description: Market slug (must exist, be active and not past close).

weightBps.description: Optional. Set on every leg or none; when set they must sum to exactly 10000. Omitted = even split.

name.description: Basket name (trimmed). Used as BOTH titleEn and titleFa; the slug is derived from it plus a random 6-char suffix (caller never chooses the slug).

legs.description: 2..10 legs. Rules (422 invalid_basket on failure): no duplicate market slugs, all slugs known, all active & not closed, close dates within 31 days of each other, weights sum 10000, minimum stake <= BASKET_MAX_MIN_STAKE_USDC (default $20).

description.description: Optional; trimmed and silently truncated to 280 chars; used for both EN and FA.

creatorName.description: Optional byline (trimmed, no control chars). Stored on the user and renames the creator everywhere. A failed rename never fails the publish.

BasketCreateResponse.description: Basket is published immediately (sizing=weights, curated=false, exclusive=false, creator = caller).

price.description: Stored mid price of the held side at apply time (becomes price_at_publish).

outcome.description: Market outcome (YES/NO/VOID) or null while open.

CommunityBasket.description: One basket card in the community feed / creator profile. Display data only.

creatorTgUserId.description: Creator user id as string (negative = web-only account). Null on editorial baskets.

creatorName.description: Chosen creator name, else Telegram display name.

creatorNameFa.description: Persian byline; client falls back to creatorName.

curated.description: House-endorsed. Editorial baskets are curated and have no creator.

editorialPersona.description: House desk, derived from legs (all-sports = daily). Null on user baskets.

status.description: archived only appears on creator profiles.

accuracy.description: Creator's settled-pick win rate; null below 5 settled picks.

weightsBps.description: Leg weights in display order (card weight bar).

multiplier.description: Σ(weight/10000)/yes_price: payout multiple if every leg resolves YES. Null if any leg is unpriced. Note: uses YES price regardless of side.

signedIn.description: Whether a valid, non-blocked viewer was resolved.

followers.description: Authoritative follower count for optimistic-toggle reconciliation.

CreatorPerf.description: Profile performance, scored at CREATION prices: $1 per fully-settled basket.

buyers.description: Distinct buyers across all their baskets.

feesUsdc.description: Lifetime sharer fees accrued+paid. Null for the house.

id.description: Numeric user id as string, or `house` / `house-daily` / `house-world`.

name.description: Always null for house profiles (client renders its brand).

settledLegs.description: House profiles and persona accounts only (leg-based record).

wonLegs.description: House profiles and persona accounts only.

baskets.description: Published then archived baskets, with `legs`; limit 60.

basket.description: Basket slug; invalid -> stored as null.

max_staleness_minutes.description: SYNC_INTERVAL_MIN (default 30): how stale the indexer-synced data may be.

ApiBasketIndexPayout.description: Per $100 staked, from stored mid prices. Null (on the parent) unless every leg is priced.

kind.description: any_winner = equal_shares (1/Σprice); all_hit = weights, independent; one_winner = weights + exclusive (value is still Σ(w/price)).

exclusive.description: At most one leg can resolve YES.

status.description: active while any leg's market is still active.

legs_total.description: Σ leg market volume, 2 dp; null for a zero-leg basket.

min_weight_bps.description: Smallest leg weight (sets the min stake). Null for a zero-leg basket.

baskets.description: status=published only (no archived), ordered curated DESC, sort_order, buy_count DESC. Unpaginated.

description.description: Polymarket resolution rules verbatim; render as text.

probability.description: Last synced mid (display only, not executable). Null when prices withheld.

outcome_labels.description: Non-null only when sides aren't literally Yes/No.

status.description: Market status, e.g. active | settled | cancelled.

outcome.description: YES / NO (or VOID) once settled; null while live.

weight_bps.description: Stored weight; for equal_shares (all legs priced) recomputed from live prices.

price.description: Mid price of the HELD side; null when unpriced.

ApiBasketPayout.description: What $100 returns if the basket comes good (mid prices). Present only when every leg is priced and the basket is not archived.

single_even.description: Set when single-winner payouts are within 1%.

ApiBasketResult.description: How $100 would have finished at CREATION prices; null until every leg settled and priced at publish. Same arithmetic as the bot's basketResultAtPublish / creatorPerf.

status.description: active while any leg market is active. Can read active on an archived basket.

archived.description: Not buyable. Gate buy CTA on this, not on `status`.

blended_probability.description: Weight-averaged held-side price, 4 dp. Null if any leg unpriced or basket archived.
